settings.err_chat_id: The chat ID is a number like -1001234567890 or a channel name like @my_channel
settings.err_emails_limit: No more than 10 addresses per form
settings.err_email_bad: “{value}” does not look like an email address
settings.err_email_typo: There seems to be a typo in the email address
settings.err_fill_all: Fill in all the fields in “{label}”
settings.err_chat_required: Set a chat for the other forms: requests will go there
settings.err_chat_ids: Check the chat IDs: they are marked in red
settings.err_max_chat_id: MAX chat ID is a number like -70000000000001. Several IDs go separated by commas
settings.err_max_chat_required: Set a MAX chat for the other forms: requests will arrive there
settings.err_max_chat_ids: Check the MAX chat IDs: they are marked in red
settings.err_mails: Check the email addresses: errors are marked in red
settings.title: Site settings
settings.subtitle: Shared data for all pages. Changes here apply as soon as you save, with no separate publishing.
settings.view_only: View only: your role cannot edit this settings section. Ask the site administrator.
settings.view_only_card: View only: your role cannot edit “{title}”. Ask the site administrator.
settings.save_fix_fields: Not saved: fix the fields marked in red
settings.save_menu_errors: Not saved: some menu items have errors
settings.saved: Saved: the changes are already on the site
settings.leave_message: There are unsaved changes in the settings ({total}). If you leave, they will be lost.
settings.switch_message: There are unsaved changes in the settings ({total}). If you switch the language now, they will be lost. To keep them, press “Save” first.
settings.scope_menus_text: Each language has its own menu: items lead to pages of that language. To edit the menu of another language, pick it on the right.
settings.scope_seo: Rules are shared by all languages: each rule can be given a language. Addresses are written in full, with a prefix for other languages: for example {example}.
settings.scope_redirects: The list is shared by all languages. Addresses are written in full, with a prefix for other languages: for example {example}.
settings.scope_notifications: Requests from any language of the site arrive in the same Telegram and MAX chats and at the same email addresses.
settings.scope_texts: The texts marked in the cards are separate for each language. Everything else is the same in all languages of the site.
settings.scope_shared: These settings are the same in all languages of the site.
settings.area_kind_nested: An item can have nested links.
settings.area_kind_flat: A plain list of links, with no nested ones.
settings.err_item_name: Name the item: without a name it will not be visible on the site
settings.err_item_url: The address must start with https:// or a slash
settings.flag_missing: There is no page with this address, so the item will not appear on the site. Choose another page.
settings.flag_missing_lang: There is no page with this address {lang}, so the item will not appear on the site. Choose another page.
settings.flag_draft: The page “{label}” is not published yet, so the item will not be on the site for now. It will appear once you publish the page.
settings.flag_draft_lang: The page “{label}” {lang} is not published yet, so the item will not be on the site for now. It will appear once you publish the page.
settings.menu_no_nesting: This area has no nested items
settings.menu_unnest_first: First move its nested items out
settings.menu_item_removed_nested: Item “{label}” deleted together with its nested items ({nested})
settings.area_delete_items: All its menu items will be lost.
settings.area_delete_items_langs: All its menu items will be lost, in all languages.
settings.area_delete_used_all: The area is inserted into all site templates. After deleting it, these pages will have no menu until the developers remove its code from the template.
settings.area_delete_used_some: The area is inserted into these templates: {templates}. After deleting it, these pages will have no menu until the developers remove its code from the template.
settings.area_delete_unused: It is not inserted into any template, so nothing will change on the site.
settings.snippet_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it manually
settings.area_used_all: Shown on all pages of the site

settings.menu_copied_gaps.one: Items copied. Translate the labels and choose pages: {count} item has no translation yet
settings.menu_copied_gaps.other: Items copied. Translate the labels and choose pages: {count} items have no translation yet

settings.menus_intro: A menu area is a place on the site where a menu is shown: the header, the footer, links to documents. Add an area, fill it with items here, and the developers will insert its code into a site template.
settings.area_copy_aria: Copy the code of the area “{name}”
settings.menu_empty: This menu has no items yet.
settings.areas_none: There are no menu areas yet. Click “Add a menu area”.
settings.area_name_required: Name the menu area, for example “Footer menu”
settings.area_added: Area “{name}” added. Now add items to it
settings.area_name_help: This is how the area is named in the admin panel: “Footer menu”, “Links for customers”.
settings.area_simple_desc: Links one under another, with no nested ones.
settings.area_nested_desc: An item can have its own links, one level deep.
settings.area_flatten_note: Nested items will become ordinary ones: they will go into the list right after their parent item, in all languages.
settings.area_new_note: The area will appear in the list at once. For the menu to show on the site, the developers will insert this code into a site template.
settings.templates_note: A template defines which fields and sections a page has and where it can be placed. Templates are added by the site developers: here you can only look at them. The template of a particular page is changed in its settings.
settings.templates_no_fields: No fields of its own: the page is built from sections
settings.templates_auto_note: the list is built automatically, there is no need to keep it manually
settings.theme_saved: Saved: the new colors are already in the panel
settings.theme_reset_message: The colors and rounded corners of the panel will return to those set by the site developer. Everyone who works in the panel will see this.
settings.theme_view_only: View only: your role cannot change the appearance of the panel. Ask the site administrator.
settings.theme_intro: The colors and rounded corners of the admin panel. The site for visitors does not change. Everyone who works in the panel sees the changes at once.
settings.theme_brand_help: The left column, main buttons and links.
settings.theme_radius_help: From square corners (0) to soft ones (16). Cards have slightly rounder corners than buttons and fields.
settings.theme_preview_hint: Preview: there is no need to save yet.
settings.theme_prev_hint_box: A hint on a light tint of the color.
settings.theme_unreadable_warn: Cannot save: text is not readable on one of the colors.
settings.theme_custom: Your colors are in effect now, not the default ones.
settings.theme_color_slip: “{value}” does not look like a color, kept {kept}. A color is written like #0B5D80.
settings.theme_readable_white: Text on this color is readable: white text, contrast {ratio} : 1 (AA requires at least 4.5).
settings.theme_readable_dark: Text on this color is readable: dark text, contrast {ratio} : 1 (AA requires at least 4.5).
settings.theme_unreadable: Text on this color is not readable: the best contrast is {ratio} : 1, but at least 4.5 is required. Make the color darker or lighter.
settings.theme_text_adjusted: When this color is used for text and links on white, the panel uses a slightly darker shade — {color} — so they stay readable.
settings.notif_hint_chat_server: Requests from forms that have no chat of their own will arrive here. For now they go to the chat from the server settings; a chat of your own will replace it
settings.notif_hint_chat: Requests from forms that have no chat of their own will arrive here
settings.notif_hint_mail: Emails from forms that have no list of their own will arrive here
settings.notif_chat_required: Set a chat: without it requests will not go anywhere
settings.notif_test_failed: Could not send the test message
settings.notif_placeholder_like_others: Same as for the other forms
settings.notif_tg_desc: A new request arrives as a Telegram message and at the same time lands in the “Requests” section. Each form can have its own chat, for example a separate one for service bookings.
settings.notif_tg_not_ready: Telegram is not connected, so messages cannot be sent.
settings.notif_accept_help: If turned off, the forms on the site will stop accepting requests.
settings.notif_tg_on_help: If turned off, requests will arrive only in the “Requests” section.
settings.notif_tg_chat_label: Telegram chat ID for the form “{form}”
settings.notif_max_chat_label: MAX chat ID for the form “{form}”
settings.notif_tg_note: You can find out a chat ID from the bot @getmyid_bot. The bot that sends notifications must be added to the chat.
settings.notif_max_desc: A new request also arrives as a message in the MAX messenger. Each form can have its own chat, and a chat field may hold several IDs separated by commas.
settings.notif_max_not_ready: MAX is not connected, so messages cannot be sent.
settings.notif_max_on_help: If turned off, requests will not go to MAX. Telegram and the “Requests” section are not affected.
settings.notif_max_note: The MAX bot must be added to the chat. Separate several chat IDs with commas.
settings.notif_mail_desc: Every new request will also arrive as an email: with the form fields and a link to the request in the panel. There can be several addresses, write them separated by commas. Empty means no emails.
settings.notif_mail_not_ready: The site mail is not set up yet, so emails will not be sent.
settings.notif_mail_ask: Ask the site administrator to set up mail.
settings.notif_mail_note: Telegram, MAX and emails work independently: if one does not arrive, the others will still come.
settings.health_sub: A page for those who keep an eye on the site: background tasks, request delivery, disk space, versions.
settings.health_load_failed: Could not get the site status
settings.health_ok_text: The queue is running, requests are delivered, there is enough disk space.
settings.health_warn_text: Nothing is broken for good, but a few things need attention. Details below.
settings.health_fail_text: Part of the site is working with errors. Details below.
settings.health_retried: The task is back in the queue. A background process will run it
settings.health_drop_message: “{label}” will not be run. This cannot be undone.
settings.health_resend_pending: No messenger is connected or turned on in settings, or no chat is set for the form, so the request was not sent
settings.health_queue_note: The site does some of its work in the background: it sends requests to Telegram and MAX and prepares smaller copies of images. Tasks wait their turn and run without anyone’s involvement.
settings.health_queue_many: A lot of tasks have piled up. Check that the background process (messenger:consume) is running.
settings.health_failed_storage: Storage for failed tasks is not set up, so errors of background tasks are not visible here.
settings.health_failed_empty_text: All tasks have run. If something fails, it will appear here.
settings.health_req_empty_text: Requests that could not be sent to a messenger will appear here.
settings.health_req_note: Names and phone numbers are not shown here. You can open the request itself in the {link} section.
settings.health_sched_empty_text: The site does not run anything on a timer. If developers add such tasks, they will show up here.
settings.health_disk_low: Free space is low. When it runs out, uploads and the cache will stop working.
settings.health_cache_note: Finished pages are kept in the cache and open without being built again. Edits made in the admin show at once, nothing has to be cleared. Clear the cache by hand only if you changed page data outside the admin, for example by importing into your own tables.
settings.health_checks_empty_text: Site extensions can add their own checks.
settings.bots_intro: Connect the {bot} bot used to deliver request notifications. The same bot is used for every site language.
settings.bots_source_admin: Token saved in the admin panel.
settings.bots_source_server: Using the token configured on the server.
settings.bots_token_help: Saved tokens are never displayed. Leave this field empty to keep the current token. A token saved here takes priority over the server configuration.
settings.bots_clear_message: After you save, the admin panel token will be removed. The server token will be used if one is configured; otherwise this bot will stop sending notifications.
settings.bots_clear_pending: The saved token will be removed when you save.
settings.bots_readonly: View only: your role cannot change bot tokens. Ask the site administrator.
settings.notif_bots_ask: Ask the site administrator to connect the bot.
settings.bots_token_admin: Token configured in the admin panel
settings.bots_telegram_hint: Create a bot and get its token from
settings.bots_max_hint: Create a bot and get its token in the MAX business tools
